verdict.rationale: Postmark's inbound docs cover parsing emails, configuring an inbound server, domain forwarding, and blocking/retry rules for inbound messages, but there is no evidence of a rules engine that matches on recipient or pattern and routes to different forward/store/POST endpoints — Postmark's inbound model is a single webhook per inbound address rather than multi-destination routing rules. missing for 10: recipient/pattern-based routing rules, multiple destination endpoints (forward vs store vs POST) per rule, any documented rules UI or API for conditional routing.
